name: com.cinematimes/showtimes
title: CinemaTimes
description: Cinema showtimes in Ireland, the UK, Australia and New Zealand, from the cinemas themselves.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Films showing at cinemas near a place on a day, ranked by how many nearby cinemas show them, with times, formats and booking links. Use for "what is on near X tonight" (window tonight). Give a place name or lat and lon.

place.description: Town, city, area or cinema neighbourhood, e.g. "Dublin", "Leicester Square", "Parramatta". A name in several countries gives the clear favourite and says so, or a list to choose from when none leads: add the country, e.g. "Newcastle, Australia". For a small town or suburb that is not found, pass its lat and lon instead.

lat.description: Latitude, with lon, instead of a place name. You can pass a town's coordinates yourself when its name is not found or is shared.

country.description: Country to search in: "ie", "uk", "au" or a country name. Optional.

date.description: today (default), tomorrow, a weekday name, weekend, or YYYY-MM-DD. Only today and future dates.

window.description: now (next 3 hours), morning, afternoon, evening (17:00 to 21:00), tonight (17:00 to the end of the day), late (21:00 on) or all (default).

format.description: Only this format: 2d, 3d, imax, 4dx, premium (premium screens: IMAX, Dolby Cinema, ScreenX, 4DX, D-BOX, the chains' own large screens (iSense, MAXX, Superscreen, EPIC, Xtremescreen, Vmax and others), LuXX and 35mm or 70mm film prints) or luxury (recliners, VIP).

radius_km.description: Search radius. Default adapts to how dense cinemas are.

tools.name: movie_showtimes

tools.name: cinema_schedule
tools.description: Everything showing at one cinema over one or more days, plus its screens and ticket prices where known.

cinema.description: Cinema name or slug, e.g. "ODEON Leicester Square", "IFI".

near.description: A town to tell same-named cinemas apart.
